brief:
Former Israeli security chief Gadi Eisenkot said elections cannot be conducted fairly while Benjamin Netanyahu remains in office, Shehab Wire reported. Hebrew media outlets reported that Netanyahu's interim government office ran a campaign on the eve of the election involving planting intelligence information with police against Arab citizens.

The allegations suggest use of state security apparatus for political purposes ahead of the vote. Eisenkot's statement reflects deepening rifts within Israeli political circles over Netanyahu's continued leadership during the electoral period.

title: Eisenkot says elections cannot be fair with Netanyahu in charge
